Great talking yesterday. Per our discussion I attached a compact commit matrix and a short list of pragmatic options to help FinApps lock predictable token economics for 2027 while preserving burst capacity. High-level options included in the PDF:

- Starter (onramp) — 10M tokens/year, small committed discount + 3-month carry-forward window
- Growth — 100M tokens/year, steeper per-token discount, soft overage buffer (10% monthly burst at reduced rate)

- Kicker credits: initial 3 months waivers of request-level streaming fees if usage is above the Growth threshold in onboarding month.
- Progressive slab pricing: larger committed buckets reduce the marginal per-token price on that bucket only (not retroactive to earlier buckets).

Alex —

Answers inline and attached a second file with the modeled scenarios you requested (20261216-finapps-mop-template.xlsx).

1) Smoothing credits: yes — credits live at the billing entity level and are usable across product orgs under the same account. We’ll reflect that in the MOP language.
2) Overage calc: overages are calculated monthly at the marginal per-token overage rate aligned to the nearest slab. For quarterly true-up customers we apply the average monthly usage to reconcile; in practice that means if you overshoot one month and undershoot the next, the quarterly true-up will net them. Growth tier includes an explicit 10% monthly burst at a discounted overage rate to accommodate spikes without immediate penalty.
3) Onboarding credit: we can offer a one-time $10k onboarding credit for Growth and $50k for Enterprise, applied at invoice following production cutover. This is structured as a service credit (non-refundable).

Attached: worked example for 120M tokens/year comparing PAYG vs Growth slab with smoothing credit applied. Key takeaway: Growth commit reduces expected token cost by ~28% vs PAYG under your ramp. I added a sensitivity tab that shows where Enterprise becomes cheaper (roughly at sustained >240M tokens/year).

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm which two tiers to model into a Firm Quote (I recommend Growth + Enterprise).
- I run legal-friendly language through Finance and return a marked SOW.
- If procurement needs, we can schedule a 30-min call to walk the MOP.

— Soojin
